messages:
maria (Mkt Ops): Quick thread — we need to lock a webinar topic + 3 short abstracts by EOD for the Apr 21 invite. I sketched 4 direction options below, please react with :one:/:two:/:three:/:four: or comment. Also add speaker suggestions.
sam (Growth): Nice. Shortlist and reactions coming. Timezone note: target NA/EMEA friendly (11am PT / 7pm CET?).
nate (Content): I'll draft 3 abstracts once we pick a direction. Can we prioritize a session that shows cost/latency tradeoffs with a live micro-demo? Buyers like measurable takeaways.
jen (Speaker Ops): Speaker availability check — call out 2 backups per slot. Also we need 1 engineer + 1 PM for the live demo lane.
alex (Product): Prefer a narrative around "predictable inference economics" — customers respond to concrete SLO examples.
maria (Mkt Ops): Options:
1) "Serving for Scale: Practical Benchmarks & Cost Strategies" — focus on throughput, batching, quantization case study.
2) "From Proof to Production: Running LLMs with Predictable Latency" — rollout + fallbacks + routing policies.
3) "Cost-conscious LLM Features: How to Ship Faster with Less GPU Spend" — product-centric, feature examples and unit economics.
4) "Realtime LLM UX: Balancing Latency & Quality with Smart Serving" — demo of latency-aware model routing.
sam (Growth): :one: and :three: look highest impact for awareness. :four: good for devx community.
nate (Content): My pick is 1 — I can write three distinct 2-3 sentence abstracts that map to different audiences (founder/infra/pm).
jen (Speaker Ops): Potential speakers: Priya (inference eng), Omar (customer success), Lena (PM) — Priya prefers demos mid-afternoon.
alex (Product): If we pick 1, I can bring a short case study (an anonymized enterprise cost drop) and a small chart.
maria (Mkt Ops): Draft abstracts — quick takes from nate:
- abstract A (technical buyers): "Serving for Scale: Practical Benchmarks & Cost Strategies" — We show real workload profiles and how batching, KV caching, and quantization reduced token cost by X% without degrading quality. Walkthrough of config knobs and a live micro-benchmark so you can reproduce results.
- abstract B (product/pm): "Serving for Scale: Practical Benchmarks & Cost Strategies" — Learn how to balance latency, cost, and model quality when shipping LLM features. We cover common tradeoffs, deployment patterns, and runbook recommendations for reliable production inference.
- abstract C (exec/biz): "Serving for Scale: Practical Benchmarks & Cost Strategies" — See how customers lowered inference spend while improving response time. Practical examples, measurable outcomes, and questions to evaluate if your team should move from experiments to reserved capacity.
sam (Growth): These map nicely to different email segments. For the invite I'd merge B + C tone and use a single clear CTA (Register + download benchmark kit).
jen (Speaker Ops): Speaker lineup suggestion: Priya (demo lead), Alex (product case), Omar (customer story). Backup: Lena, Sam.
rehearsal-bot: Reminder: rehearsal slots open Tue/Wed 9–11am PT. Book by EOD Mon.
maria (Mkt Ops): Run-of-show (first pass):
- 00:00–00:05 Welcome + goals (host)
- 00:05–00:20 Benchmark primer & product context (alex)
- 00:20–00:35 Live micro-demo + config walk (priya)
- 00:35–00:45 Customer example + lessons (omar)
- 00:45–00:55 Q&A + polling (all)
- 00:55–01:00 CTA + download link / next steps
nate (Content): For the demo script I'll prepare a failover path if GPU pool is saturated (pre-recorded demo snippet + live fallback script). Also will include a 2-slide backup showing raw numbers.
alex (Product): Can the demo show the same prompt on two routing policies (latency-first vs cost-first)? That'd make the tradeoffs obvious.
priya (in a reply thread): I can do two runs, but need the pre-recorded clip for the worst-case. Also need model configs and a reproducible repo link.
jen (Speaker Ops): Action items:
- nate: finalize 3 abstracts and 1 marquee invite copy (due EOD)
- maria: set recording + registration page (today)
- priya: produce pre-recorded demo clip (due Wed)
- alex: provide anonymized chart + 1 slide (due Thu)
- sam: segment invite list + test-send (due Fri)
- everyone: pick a rehearsal slot (rehearsal-bot above)
sam (Growth): For lead routing, let's tag registrants by persona selection (Product / Engineering / Exec) and add utm=benchmarks-serve to links. QA: make sure the webhook to SFDC maps persona to lead queue.
maria (Mkt Ops): Agreed. Also add a follow-up nurture: 3 emails (thank you + benchmark kit, demo deep-dive, try-redwood trial credit).
jen (Speaker Ops): Quick note on timing: if we aim 11am PT, rehearsals need to be 10am PT on the day — confirm availability.
nate (Content): I'll spin up invite subject lines (A/B test): "Serving for Scale: Benchmarks, Cost, and How We Ship" vs "Lower LLM Cost Without Sacrificing Latency — Practical Tips" — will share in the morning.
sam (Growth): :thumbsup: Also suggest a short 60s social clip from the pre-recorded demo for LinkedIn/X promos.
maria (Mkt Ops): Great. If no objections by EOD, we lock direction 1 and these action items. Thanks team — will send a consolidated TODO thread.
